_comment: Badges recognise reflection and effort, never mood. Nothing here is earned by feeling better, keeping a streak, or scoring well, and nothing implies recovery or treatment working. Every rule is deterministic and evaluated in app/core/badges.py against completed entries only; the model never awards a badge. 'how' is shown to the user so an earned badge is always explainable.

badges.name: Finding My Rhythm
badges.description: You came back, on your own days.

badges.name: Four Ways to Reflect
badges.description: You have tried every kind of journal here.
badges.how: Completed at least one check-in, savouring, thought record and exposure reflection.

badges.name: Thought Explorer
badges.description: You looked closely at a thought instead of carrying it.

badges.name: Another Perspective
badges.description: You found a different way to see something.

badges.name: Pattern Noticer
badges.description: You spotted the same thinking pattern more than once.
badges.how: Noticed one thinking pattern in two or more separate thought records.

badges.name: Moment Keeper
badges.description: You held on to something good.

badges.name: Learning to Notice
badges.description: You have written down what you are learning about yourself.
badges.how: Recorded three separate learnings — from a thought record, a savouring moment, or an exposure step.

badges.name: Brave First Step
badges.description: You reflected on something you had been avoiding.
